description: Present-day surface levels (m) of big deep lakes whose bed, not surface, ETOPO 2022 holds (owner decision, 2026-11-25). Each entry is a point inside the lake and its surface level. In modes with data lakes, the depression basin holding the lattice node nearest the point becomes a data lake at this level. overview_m is the 5-arc-minute overview's value at the point, sampled by the controller; Task 11 re-checks it against the real overview. Read by timefly_core (compiled in) and the Python reference pass (Task 11).

lakes.name: Caspian Sea
lakes.source: Wikipedia, Caspian Sea; DAHITI satellite altimetry (https://dahiti.dgfi.tum.de/39/); 2025 record-low reports
lakes.note: long-run average about -26 to -27 m (Baltic datum); 2025 about -29.4 m
lakes.endorheic_source: Wikipedia, 'Caspian Sea' (read 2026-11-26): 'An endorheic basin, it is situated in both Europe and Asia'; infobox type 'Endorheic', outflow 'Evaporation'. The flag makes the lake terminal whatever its balance, and its nodes below its level seed routing like the sea at that level (rivers Task 11d fix round 2).
